data.name: Glow-Up or Give Back
data.headline: 57 days to Diwali. Glow up, or we give back.
data.benefit: 57 days to Diwali. We measure you on day 1 and again before the festive photos. Do 30 classes and don't improve? Your third month is on us.
data.rationale: New clients' first 60-day spend averages ₹11,150 at Kwality, ₹8,411 at Bandra and ₹6,747 at Kenkere — under one month's list price. A 2-month bundle doubles it; the 30-class condition makes the guarantee rarely paid.
data.conditions: Standard 15% only; guarantee paid in time.
data.kpi: Bundles sold; day-56 re-test attendance; 3rd-month purchases.

data.rationale: These clients bought big before; a long plan at a serious price fits them. A personal call converts better than a broadcast.

data.rationale: October–December are troughs (Kwality Nov-25 ₹18.5L; Bandra Oct-25 ₹10.2L). Locking 3M before the festive season protects the base.
